mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Transactions (product_id, buyer_email, seller_email, transaction_status, transaction_date, payment_status, price, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{buyerEmail}, #{sellerEmail}, '진행중', NOW(), '미완료', #{price}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM Transactions WHERE id = #{id} AND (buyer_email = #{email} OR seller_email = #{email})
SELECT * FROM Transactions WHERE id = #{id} AND (buyer_email = #{email} OR seller_email = #{email}) FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE Transactions SET transaction_status = '완료', payment_status = '완료', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND transaction_status = '진행중' AND payment_status = '미완료'
